initialExam.title: Delhi Police Constable 2025-26
initialExam.description: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) recruitment. 2025-26 cycle completed — written exam held Dec 2025-Jan 2026. Next cycle notification awaited.
initialExam.syllabus: General Knowledge/Awareness (50Q), Reasoning (25Q), Numerical Ability (15Q), English/Hindi (25Q).
initialExam.examPattern: CBT: 100 questions, 100 marks, 90 minutes. PET/PST/Medical mandatory.
initialExam.selectionProcess: CBT → PET/PST → Medical → DV → Final Selection
initialExam.careerGrowth: Constable → Head Constable → ASI → SI → Inspector.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit ssc.gov.in 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Uniform Allowance, Delhi Police allowances, Medical
